title: Item:Sentient Jewel of the Hopeful
wikitext:
{{Consumable
  | picdesc     = Sentient Jewel of the Hopeful.png
  | acquired    = <!--Name of NPC-->
  | location    = Ravenloft intro quest reward
  | turnin      = <!-- What is needed to get the item. Leave Blank if None -->
  | minlevel    = 20
  | bind        = {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}
  | effect      = A jewel that holds [[Sentient Weapon|sentient power]].
  | cost        = 350 pp
  | weight      = 0.01 lbs
  | stack       = <!-- Stack size for this consumable - default 100 -->
  | description = A jewel that holds sentient power. Click on the Sentient Item button on the right side of the inventory panel (or drag a weapon to that slot) to open the sentient Item panel.
  | notes       = Voiced by [[Rachel Butera]].
:* On first slotting
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: ?
:* On first equip
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: ?
:* Random in combat
:: (Say): "EEEEUURRRAH!  Nice one!"
:: (Say): "Down they go!"
:: (Say): "You're really good at this!"
:: (Say): "Terrific!  We're off on an adventure!"
:* On unequiping
:: (Say): "That was fun. I look forward to working with you in the future."
:* On feeding
:: (Say): "More please! The more we do that, the better it is for both of us."
:* On re-equipping (or logging in)
:: (Say): "I can't wait to tell the stories of our travels."
:: (Say): "So what's on for today? Creatures to slay, evil overlords to depose?"
:* Opening a chest
:: (Say): "Isn't this the best part of adventuring?"
:: (Say): "Oooh, open it quick!"
:* Injury
:: (Say): "Are you alright?  Is there a cleric in the house?"
:: (Say): "They never mention stuff like this happening in stories."
:* Shrining
:: (Say): "Nothing like a well deserved rest."
:: (Say): "Ah. A nice quiet moment for me to work on the story of your adventures."
:* Quest acquisition
:: (Say): "We're going where to do what?  That sounds amazing!"
:* Quest completion
:: (Say): "I can't believe we did it!"
:* Quest reward
:: (Say): "I can't believe we did it!"
:* Unlocking a filigree slot
:: (Say): "I wonder what you'll pick? So many choices!"
:* Slotting a filigree
:: (Say): "As my power grows, so does yours!"
:* Party member death
:: (Say): "Your poor friend. I hope they get better."
:: (Say): "And so fell your brave adventuring companion, far too soon."
:* Player death
:: (Say): "You can't die, you're too good for that! I'm sure you'll get better soon."
:: (Say): "Well. Maybe a Cleric will wander by."
:* Resurrection
:: (Say): "Good to see you up and about. Let's get going!"
:: (Say): "So, what was death like?"
:: (Say): "Back in action!"
:* Triggering a trap
:: (Say): "So that's what a trap going off looks like."
:* Knocked down
:: (Say): "This is kind of embarassing for both of us."  (With a vocalized:: (Say): "Ohh," at the start which doesn't register in chat.)
}}
